fact: On 1 January 2026 Principal Secretary Julius Bitok said KEMIS, due to go live on 9 January 2026, will integrate basic education, higher education, TVET and agencies such as KNEC and TSC, with backend preparations under way with the Ministry of ICT and Konza Technopolis.
title: Government to roll out KEMIS on January 9, 2026, to track learners nationwide
